could_this_be_cooler: The dossier's own answer is right and I will not repeat it, but playing it adds one concrete point: Phil is four Flying types with no answer at all to a single spread Rock or Electric attack, and the fight resolved in four turns because one Pokemon (Magnezone) walled and killed three quarters of the team. The cheapest fix that keeps the bird-keeper theme is to give one member a non-Flying secondary identity - Farfetch'd-Galar (Fighting, Leek + Focus Energy) instead of base Farfetch'd would keep Defiant-adjacent flavour, break the four-way shared Electric/Rock weakness, and stop Magnezone from being a one-Pokemon answer to a whole trainer. Flagged, not changed.
